metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions (Matomo, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Unlighthouse). v2.4.0 adds /seo agentic for agent readiness (Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, AI agent access), keeps installer secrets off the command line, and fixes #312, #314 and #317.
